divergences.because: spec 4.2: get and all read one merged tree, objects merging key by key, so get("a") carries the default a.c beside the file's a.b, where basekit answered the file's a alone
spec 4.2: all is the same merged tree get reads, so all().a.c is get("a.c"), where basekit's all merged shallowly and dropped the default a.c
spec 4.2: a file value of null replaces the default whole, so a.b is absent under a null a, where basekit's get fell through to the default a.b
spec 4.2: an array from the file replaces the default array whole, so list.1 is absent under the file's [9], where basekit's get fell through to the default list.1
spec 4.2: set's previous is the merged value the plugin saw before the write, the default included, where basekit's set reported the file's value alone and so an absent from

failure.message: the settings file is not a readable JSON object, so setting would discard its content
failure.fix: repair {home}/config/p.json so it holds one JSON object, or remove it, then set again; it was left unchanged

divergences.because: spec 4.2 and rev 141: a set into a malformed settings file is refused and writes nothing, where basekit rewrote it as the one key and wiped the file's content

failure.message: the key crosses a value in the settings file that is not an object
failure.fix: {home}/config/p.json holds a value that is not an object on the way to "a.b"; edit that file by hand

divergences.because: spec 4.2: a set whose path crosses a value in the file that is not an object is refused, where basekit replaced that value with an object

failure.message: the argument carries no usable key
failure.fix: send {"key": "a.b"} with one or more dot separated, non-empty segments

divergences.because: spec 4.2: a set key with an empty segment is refused, where basekit wrote a member named by the empty string

spec 4.2: the settings file lives in the config directory paths.resolve answers, so a home that renamed it to settings writes settings/p.json, where basekit hard-coded config/ and left ctx.paths.config and ctx.config apart
spec 4.2 and rev 141: there is no top-level <name>.json fallback, so a file beside the config directory is not read, where basekit read it when config/<name>.json was absent

failure.message: the plugin's config name is not a usable file name
failure.fix: name the plugin, or set config.name, to one portable path segment such as "my-plugin"

divergences.because: spec 3 and rev 146: a config.name of ../x is not one portable path segment and is refused, where basekit joined it unchecked and read outside the config directory
spec 3 and rev 146: every call reads the file, so a hand edit is seen at the next get, where basekit cached the file for the life of the process
spec 4.3: each level carries its own tag in the log file, where basekit wrote [INFO] DEBUG and [INFO] WARN
spec 4.3: the logging gate reads the merged setting, so a manifest defaulting logging to false writes no log file, where basekit read only the settings file
spec 4.3 and rev 146: CORE_LOG_CONSOLE is not carried, the settings file decides, where basekit printed every line while the variable was set
spec 3 and rev 146: a directory name holding : is not a portable path segment on every OS, so the default config is used, where basekit accepted any name free of / and \

failure.message: the log line could not be appended
failure.fix: check that the home's logs directory can be created and written

divergences.because: spec 4.3 and 6: a failed log write with no console line due answers a failure, which the host swallows, where basekit swallowed it itself; an error's console line is still answered, as call 0 shows
